text: I notice you haven't answered my previous questions about abdominal symptoms or your smoking and alcohol history. Could you please clarify if you experience any pain, changes in bowel habits, or difficulty swallowing, and confirm your history of smoking or heavy alcohol use?

text: Past medical history: Has a history of diabetes mellitus type II, hypertension, non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated in the past, and hypercholesterolemia. Social history: Currently smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and drinks a glass of wine daily. Denies any illicit drug use.

text: Given your significant weight loss and history of smoking, I need to check for signs of malignancy or infection. REQUEST TEST: CT_Chest_Abdomen_Pelvis.
